policy.productionRule: A recipe may not be nutrient-approved while any non-optional ingredient lacks an exact FoodData Central ID and preparation-state match.
policy.composites: Undefined mixtures must be decomposed into weighed component ingredients. A convenient single database record is not an acceptable substitute.
policy.stateRule: Raw, cooked, drained, rehydrated, and prepared states are separate mappings when FoodData Central distinguishes them.
